articles.title: Assault Allegations Rock Noida: Man Claims Police Inaction After Attack on Family
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Serious allegations have emerged from Noida, where a man has accused his wife and in-laws of brutally assaulting him and his elderly parents, while also claiming inaction by the police.

body.html:
Serious allegations have emerged from Noida, where a man has accused his wife and in-laws of brutally assaulting him and his elderly parents, while also claiming inaction by the police.

According to Deepak Singh, the incident took place on March 27, 2026, during which he and his senior citizen parents allegedly sustained serious injuries. He has alleged that despite the severity of the incident, Police Station Sector 24 has neither registered an FIR nor initiated any action so far.

Describing the situation as a grave failure of law enforcement, Deepak has sought urgent intervention from higher authorities, demanding immediate registration of an FIR, arrest of the accused, and protection for his family.

He has also warned that if justice is not delivered promptly, he will escalate the matter through legal channels and public platforms.

As of now, no official statement has been issued by the police regarding the allegations, and the claims remain unverified.

#Noida #BreakingNews #UPPolice #AssaultCase #LawAndOrder

articles.title: ₹4 Lakh Job Scam Sparks Street Drama in Prayagraj: Woman Thrashes Accused with Slippers
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic scene unfolded in Prayagraj when a woman allegedly thrashed a young man with slippers in a busy market after accusing him of cheating her family of ₹4 lakh on the pretext of securing a job.

body.html:
A dramatic scene unfolded in Prayagraj when a woman allegedly thrashed a young man with slippers in a busy market after accusing him of cheating her family of ₹4 lakh on the pretext of securing a job.

The incident took place on Monday (30 March 2026) afternoon at the Naini Meva Lal Bagiya intersection. The accused, identified as Anoop Pandey, had allegedly taken money in instalments from the victim’s family over two years, promising a job in the Agriculture Department but neither fulfilling the promise nor returning the amount.

According to the complainant, Ritu Tiwari, her husband Brajesh Tiwari, an e-rickshaw driver, had met the accused earlier, leading to repeated financial transactions based on job assurances. Over time, the accused reportedly stopped answering calls and avoided contact.

On spotting him at the intersection, the woman confronted him and demanded her money back. The accused allegedly tried to evade the situation by asking for a barcode and fled when she took out her phone. Alerted by her cries, locals chased and caught him.

Amid the commotion, the woman began hitting him with slippers in full public view, leading to a temporary road blockade as a crowd gathered.

Police reached the spot and took the accused into custody. A panchayat was held at the police station for nearly an hour before further proceedings.

Sunil Kumar Singh stated that the accused has been detained and the matter is under investigation.

The victim’s family has alleged prolonged harassment over the unpaid money and demanded strict action.

#Prayagraj #BreakingNews #JobScam #FraudCase #ViralVideo

articles.title: Dowry Horror in Agra: Cop Accused of Poisoning Wife Over Fortuner Demand, Flees After Incident
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of alleged dowry harassment and attempted murder has surfaced from Agra, where a police inspector is accused of poisoning his wife over demands for a flat and a Fortuner SUV.

body.html:
A shocking case of alleged dowry harassment and attempted murder has surfaced from Agra, where a police inspector is accused of poisoning his wife over demands for a flat and a Fortuner SUV.

According to the victim, Meenakshi, a resident of Chandpur village in Faridabad, her husband Lokesh Bhati—posted at New Agra police station—had been pressuring her for dowry since their marriage in April 2021. The couple lives in a rented house in Lawyers Colony and has a six-month-old child.

Meenakshi alleged that despite receiving a Scorpio during the wedding, her husband continued demanding a Fortuner and a flat, often assaulting her over the issue. On Sunday afternoon, an argument reportedly broke out again over the same demand, after which Lokesh allegedly beat her and forced her to consume poison.

As her condition deteriorated, the accused allegedly fled the house. Neighbours rushed her to a nearby hospital, after which her family shifted her to Mathura and later to SN Medical College in Agra for advanced treatment.

The victim further claimed that she had earlier approached the police station with complaints, but was allegedly discouraged, with remarks that no action could be taken against a police officer.

Her family has also alleged continued harassment by the accused’s relatives and accused local police of inaction and intimidation.

Meanwhile, Lokesh Bhati has denied the allegations, stating that there was only a minor dispute and claiming that his wife consumed a substance on her own. He termed the dowry harassment allegations as false.

Police are yet to issue a detailed official statement on the case, and further investigation is awaited.

#Agra #BreakingNews #DowryHarassment #CrimeNews #UPPolice

articles.title: Media Worker Brutally Assaulted in Ghaziabad: Mob Attack, Firing on Street Caught on CCTV
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A media worker was seriously injured in a brutal attack in the Delhi Gate area under Kotwali police station limits in Ghaziabad on Sunday night, after being allegedly assaulted by a group of over 10 youths.

body.html:
A media worker was seriously injured in a brutal attack in the Delhi Gate area under Kotwali police station limits in Ghaziabad on Sunday night, after being allegedly assaulted by a group of over 10 youths.

According to reports, the victim, identified as Akash, who is associated with a Hindi newspaper, was attacked on the street when he stepped out during an argument nearby. The accused allegedly surrounded him, chased him, and then pinned him to the ground before beating him with sticks.

Eyewitness accounts and CCTV footage show the attackers creating chaos on the road for nearly 10 minutes. During the assault, they also allegedly fired in the air with pistols and issued death threats before fleeing the spot.

The injured victim was rushed to a district hospital, where doctors confirmed multiple serious injuries, including a fractured wrist, a broken leg, and rib injuries.

Police have registered a case based on the complaint and are identifying the accused using CCTV footage. Rajkaran Nair stated that strict action will be taken and any negligence by police personnel will also be investigated.

Questions have also been raised over the delay in police response, as officials reportedly reached the scene later.

Authorities have clarified that individuals from different communities are involved, and action will be taken against all accused.

#Ghaziabad #BreakingNews #MobAttack #CrimeNews

articles.title: Wild Elephant Rampage in Hassan: Auto-Rickshaw Tossed, Villagers Panic in Belur Taluk
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic gripped residents of Kuppugodu village in Belur taluk of Hassan after a lone wild elephant went on a rampage early in the morning.

body.html:
Panic gripped residents of Kuppugodu village in Belur taluk of Hassan after a lone wild elephant went on a rampage early in the morning.

According to locals, the elephant strayed into the village and approached the house of a resident, Krishnappa, where it attacked an auto-rickshaw parked nearby. In a dramatic sequence captured on mobile phones, the animal was seen lifting and tossing the vehicle, causing heavy damage.

The sudden intrusion left Krishnappa’s family and nearby residents terrified as the elephant displayed aggressive behaviour.

After the incident, the elephant reportedly moved into a nearby plantation, continuing to trumpet loudly and creating fear in the surrounding area.

Forest officials are expected to monitor the situation closely to prevent further escalation and ensure the safety of villagers.

#Hassan #Karnataka #Wildlife #ElephantAttack #BreakingNews

articles.title: DJ Party Clash Turns Deadly: Retired Brigadier Killed by Stray Bullet in Dehradun
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident in Dehradun claimed the life of a 74-year-old retired Army officer after a late-night dispute at a nightclub escalated into a violent shooting on the streets. The victim, Brigadier V.K.

body.html:
A shocking incident in Dehradun claimed the life of a 74-year-old retired Army officer after a late-night dispute at a nightclub escalated into a violent shooting on the streets.

The victim, Brigadier V.K. Joshi (Retd), was out for his morning walk around 6:30 am when he was hit by a stray bullet fired during a clash between two groups.

According to police, the violence stemmed from an argument inside a nightclub over DJ music selection. The dispute continued outside and escalated when one group, travelling in a Scorpio, allegedly chased another group in a Fortuner.

During the chase, occupants of the Scorpio reportedly opened fire at the Fortuner and attacked its passengers with iron rods and sticks. Eyewitnesses said both vehicles were moving at high speed while shots were being fired, creating panic in the area.

Several occupants of the Fortuner sustained serious injuries in the attack.

Amid the firing, a stray bullet struck Brigadier Joshi, who was walking nearby. He was rushed to hospital but succumbed to his injuries during treatment.

Eyewitness Kuldeep Bisht stated that the attackers were firing repeatedly, making the situation extremely dangerous. Locals said the consequences could have been worse had more pedestrians been present at that hour.

Police have launched an investigation into the incident and are examining links to the earlier nightclub altercation. Efforts are underway to identify and apprehend those involved.

#Dehradun #BreakingNews #Shooting #RoadRage #CrimeNews

articles.title: Passenger Arrested After Smoking, Misbehaviour and False Claims in Bengaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A viral video showing a passenger smoking on an airport tarmac and behaving aggressively with staff has triggered outrage, with the accused later arrested in Bengaluru for multiple offences.

body.html:
A viral video showing a passenger smoking on an airport tarmac and behaving aggressively with staff has triggered outrage, with the accused later arrested in Bengaluru for multiple offences.

The individual, identified as Utkarsh Gautam, is seen in the footage openly smoking despite repeated warnings from ground staff that smoking is strictly prohibited. He allegedly ignored instructions, argued with officials, and demanded proof of no-smoking rules, repeatedly asking, “Show me where’s the no-smoking rule?”

The situation escalated when he reportedly blew cigarette smoke toward a staff member and challenged personnel in an aggressive manner, creating an unsafe environment at the airport.

The incident is linked to a broader case involving Gautam’s conduct on an IndiGo flight from Jaipur to Bengaluru on March 22. According to airline staff, he was allegedly under the influence of alcohol, attempted to open the aircraft’s emergency exit mid-air, and verbally abused the cabin crew.

Following a complaint by airline authorities, police at Kempegowda International Airport initially registered a Non-Cognisable Report (NCR) and released him after inquiry.

However, the matter took a serious turn when Gautam later posted allegedly false and derogatory claims on social media, accusing the police of harassment.

Taking suo motu cognisance, airport police registered a fresh case and subsequently arrested him for spreading misleading information and defaming law enforcement, in addition to the earlier allegations.

Officials stated that strict action has been initiated considering both the in-flight misconduct and the attempt to mislead the public.

#Bengaluru #AirportDrama #BreakingNews #IndiGo #ViralVideo

articles.title: Chilling Murder in Vizag: Navy Technician Kills Girlfriend, Dismembers Body, Surrenders to Police
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A gruesome murder case has shocked Visakhapatnam after a naval technician allegedly killed his girlfriend, dismembered her body, and hid the remains inside his rented flat in the Gajuwaka area.

body.html:
A gruesome murder case has shocked Visakhapatnam after a naval technician allegedly killed his girlfriend, dismembered her body, and hid the remains inside his rented flat in the Gajuwaka area.

The accused, identified as Chintada Ravindra, a technician posted at INS Dega, was arrested after he surrendered at the Gajuwaka police station and confessed to the crime.

According to police, the victim, Polipalli Mounika (29), had been in a relationship with Ravindra since 2021. On the day of the incident, he allegedly called her to his residence while his wife was away at her parental home.

Investigators said an argument broke out between the two, reportedly over financial disputes and threats to expose their relationship. The confrontation allegedly escalated, during which Ravindra stabbed Mounika to death.

Police revealed that the accused had earlier attempted to procure knives, indicating possible premeditation. After the murder, he allegedly cut the body into multiple parts. Some remains were stored in a refrigerator, while others were packed into a bag and hidden inside the house. The victim’s head was reportedly taken to an isolated location and burned, and is yet to be recovered.

Following the crime, Ravindra contacted a friend and later surrendered to the police, leading to the discovery of the muder. Police teams recovered body parts from the house, while a special team has been formed to trace the missing remains.

Officials said Ravindra’s wife had recently delivered a child and was staying away from the residence, leaving him alone at the time of the incident.

A murder case has been registered, and forensic examination is underway to establish the full sequence of events. The brutal nature of the crime has left residents in shock, with investigators continuing efforts to uncover all details.

#Visakhapatnam #BreakingNews #MurderCase #CrimeNews

articles.title: Drunk Driving Horror in Bengaluru: Wrong-Side Crash Kills 2 Near Wakf Board Office
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident in Bengaluru claimed two lives after a car allegedly driven under the influence of alcohol rammed into a two-wheeler near the Wakf Board office under High Grounds traffic police limits on Saturday night.

body.html:
A tragic road accident in Bengaluru claimed two lives after a car allegedly driven under the influence of alcohol rammed into a two-wheeler near the Wakf Board office under High Grounds traffic police limits on Saturday night.

The deceased have been identified as Zubair Ahmed (42) and Abdul Munneer Pasha (16), who were reportedly riding in accordance with traffic rules when the accident occurred.

According to police, the accused driver, identified as Ayyappa, was driving a Volkswagen car in an inebriated state. He allegedly entered a one-way road from the wrong direction at high speed and collided head-on with the victims’ two-wheeler.

The impact was severe, resulting in the instant death of both riders.

Officials from High Grounds Traffic Police rushed to the spot and carried out a preliminary inspection. The accused was taken into custody, and medical examination reportedly confirmed alcohol consumption at the time of the incident.

A case has been registered against the driver, and further legal action is underway.

#Bengaluru #BreakingNews #RoadAccident #DrunkDriving #Karnataka

articles.title: Vrindavan | Devotees Allegedly Beaten by Security at Banke Bihari Temple
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major controversy has erupted at Banke Bihari Temple in Vrindavan after private security personnel were accused of assaulting devotees during a late-night altercation near the temple premises.

body.html:
A major controversy has erupted at Banke Bihari Temple in Vrindavan after private security personnel were accused of assaulting devotees during a late-night altercation near the temple premises.

According to reports, the incident took place around 9:40 pm on Sunday after the temple had closed. Some devotees who arrived at Gate No. 1 to offer prayers were reportedly asked to leave by security staff, leading to an argument that quickly escalated into a scuffle.

Eyewitness videos show multiple security guards allegedly slapping and punching devotees. A woman devotee is also seen trying to intervene. The situation intensified when more security personnel arrived and allegedly joined in the assault.

A shopkeeper, identified as Yogesh, who attempted to record the incident, was also allegedly attacked by the guards. Following this, other local shopkeepers gathered, leading to further confrontation.

Shopkeepers alleged that they later went to the guards’ barracks, where they were reportedly confined and assaulted. Serious allegations have also been made against a police official, Subodh Malik, who was accused of supporting the security personnel. In an off-camera remark, he allegedly admitted to hitting individuals, though he avoided commenting on record.

On the other hand, security officials, including Atal Yadav of the Rajasthan Security Company, claimed that the dispute began when devotees attempted to enter through the exit gate despite announcements restricting entry after the Shayan Aarti. They alleged that locals later entered the barracks and abused the guards, escalating the situation.

Further allegations have emerged that women devotees were manhandled and pushed. Some devotees claimed they were asked for money and assaulted when they refused. One injured woman reportedly stated she would never return to Vrindavan and would discourage others as well.

Following the incident, police detained more than eight individuals from both sides and are currently investigating the matter. Complaints have been filed by both parties, and CCTV footage from the temple premises is being reviewed.

The incident has triggered widespread outrage, raising serious concerns over crowd management, security conduct, and the safety of devotees at major religious sites.

#Vrindavan #BankeBihariTemple #BreakingNews #DevoteeSafety
